notes.title: [Just Squat] Demo Patch 0.1
notes.content:
Considering the difficulty level after the demo version, all accessary exercise values ​​have been adjusted.

Cable Raise: Adjusted the bullet start angle and location, reduced the number of bullets
Dumbbell Raise: Adjusted the bullet circumference and rotation speed
Kettlebell Raise: Adjusted the number of bullets
Dumbbell Press: Reduced the limit for maintaining maximum bullets
Bench Press: Slightly increased bullet speed, slightly increased cooldown
Calf Raise: Slightly reduced bullet speed
Lunge: Changed bullet firing from 2 to 1
Leg Press: Increased the number of bullets emitted
Deadlift: Increased the number of bullets emitted and changed the path randomly each time they were emitted.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Just Squat] Demo version released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=h0A88QOy7NE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]The demo of [Just Squat] has finally been released![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172980/f183d558b42c1f2bf842ba52be9a22d29f837424.png[/img]
[b]Watch how a bullied student overcomes bullying and injustice![/b]

[Just Squat] begins with the bullied student 'Kim Newbie' exercising to change his situation.

In this demo version, you can see 'Kim Newbie' starting to exercise and meet strange people at the gym.
There are two random stories prepared for each stage, so enjoy it lightly and fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172980/35cb6f322951fb061d6fb8d39b833e80af229fbb.png[/img]
[b]Increasingly difficult squat bosses await you! It's definitely not easy, so brace yourself![/b]

There are a total of 4 bosses prepared in this demo version.
If you fail the squat, you won't be able to meet the next boss even if you move on to the next stage! 
If you want to meet the last boss, try to successfully complete all stages of the squat!

Choose the exercises that suit you and continue to fight against the squat bosses to conquer them! 

As the stages go up, the squat bosses get more and more difficult. In particular, the stage 4 boss is on a whole other level of difficulty than the stage 1~3 bosses!

[b]A combination of bullet hell & shmup and visual novel genres! A sweaty workout game [Just Squat]![/b]

If you're looking forward to the game, add it to your wishlist! Don't miss the official release news!
I'll always listen carefully to your feedback on [Just Squat]. Feel free to talk about the game!
